title: CPP confirms death of senior NPA member, 3 others in Agusan clash

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur—The Communist Party of the Philippines–North Central Mindanao Region (CPP-NCMR) has acknowledged the death of a senior member in a firefight with government troops in Agusan del Sur. The group identified the cadre as Julia Cagadas-Lastimosa, alias “Ka Rida.” The fatality comes along with three other New People’s Army (NPA) members following an armed encounter with government forces in Barangay Bakingking, Esperanza last Saturday. The acknowledgment was contained in a statement released Tuesday by the CPP-NCMR and circulated through communist movement information channels.
